title.zh: 反馈至多计入影响闭包，部分在所到达之处计入：平衡的流中水平随其交换；在某步之前没有到达的，在该步有与无部分时同样被接纳
title.en: Feedback registers at most the influence closure, and a part registers where it reaches: in a balanced flow levels follow their exchanges; whatever a part has not reached before a step is admitted alike with and without it there

claim.zh: 在平衡的流中，两个流在一个条件上起始、取用与给予相同，就使它在每步相同（Flow.Balances.levels_agree）；所以形成的支持只计入与其所依存者的交换：在其所需与依存一致的两个网上，两个流在它所依存的每个条件上起始、取用与给予相同，它在每步就同样被支持（Flow.Balances.support_agrees）。扣留一个部分时，两种水平在某步于一个条件上相同，恰当此前部分向它给予的等于从它取用的（Flow.Balances.agrees_iff_even）；部分不向条件给予时，扣留它不降低条件（Flow.Balances.le_withheld），只取用的部分被扣留时只能是增益或无（Flow.Balances.admits_without_taker）；成员都不与条件交换时两种水平相同（Flow.Balances.agrees_of_quiet）；某步不同之处，必有成员在更早的步与它交换（Flow.Balances.exchanges_before_of_differs、exchanges_of_differs）。影响闭包之外的不与闭包成员所依存的条件交换（Flow.beyond_influence），所以成员都在影响闭包之外的部分到达不了闭包之内（Flow.unreached_within_influence），闭包之内的每个形成在每步有部分时被支持，恰当无部分的水平接纳它（Flow.Balances.unregistered_beyond_influence）：部分在闭包之外终结的，在闭包之内都不被计入。Clearing 中清除者清除与不清除栖息地时，两个流都平衡，活动需要支持，清除者每步同样被支持且活跃，而栖居者在不清除时每步活跃、清除时从第 3 步起不活跃（Clearing.unregistered、Clearing.resource_of_clearer）。部分到达一个形成（Flow.Reaches），是指成员与它所依存的条件交换；在某步之前到达（Flow.ReachesBefore），是指成员在更早的步与它在该步所需的条件交换（Flow.ReachesBefore.reaches）。形成在某步所需的每个条件上，两种水平相同，或部分在该步之前到达它（Flow.Balances.agrees_or_reaches_before、agrees_or_reaches）；在某步之前没有到达的，在该步有与无部分时同样被接纳（Flow.Balances.admits_unreached_before、admits_unreached）。交换在依存之后时，形成被影响、被到达，却在每步之前都没有被到达，有与无部分时每步都同样被接纳（Late.affected_without_effect）。成员在一个对影响封闭的区域之内的部分只到达区域之内（Flow.reaches_within_closed）；所及闭包与系统都是这样的区域（Flow.reaches_withinReach、Flow.reaches_withinSystem），系统之外的部分到达不了系统之内（Flow.unreached_within_system），形成自身的部分在其所及闭包与系统之内（Flow.own_within_reach、Flow.own_within_system）；清除者的部分是它自身的，并到达栖居者（Clearing.clearer_own、Clearing.reaches_dweller）。不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Two balanced flows that start a condition alike, and take from it and give to it alike, keep it alike at every step (Flow.Balances.levels_agree); so a formation's support registers only the exchanges with what it depends on: on two webs that agree on what it requires and needs, two flows that start, take and give alike on every condition it depends on support it alike at every step (Flow.Balances.support_agrees). With a part withheld the levels agree on a condition at a step exactly when, before it, the part has given the condition what it has taken from it (Flow.Balances.agrees_iff_even); withholding a part that gives a condition nothing never lowers it (Flow.Balances.le_withheld), and withholding a part that only takes registers as gain or nothing (Flow.Balances.admits_without_taker); the levels agree on a condition none of its members exchanges with (Flow.Balances.agrees_of_quiet), and where they differ at a step some member exchanged with it at an earlier step (Flow.Balances.exchanges_before_of_differs, exchanges_of_differs). Nothing beyond a formation's influence closure exchanges with a condition a member depends on (Flow.beyond_influence), so a part whose members all lie beyond it reaches nothing within it (Flow.unreached_within_influence), and each formation within it is supported with the part exactly where the levels without the part admit it, at every step (Flow.Balances.unregistered_beyond_influence): whatever the part ends beyond the closure registers nowhere within it. In Clearing, whether or not the clearer clears the habitat, both flows balance, activity needs support, and the clearer is supported and active alike at every step, while the dweller is active at every step with the habitat spared and inactive from the third step on with it cleared (Clearing.unregistered, Clearing.resource_of_clearer). A part reaches a formation (Flow.Reaches) when a member exchanges with a condition the formation depends on, and reaches it before a step (Flow.ReachesBefore) when a member exchanged, at an earlier step, with a condition the formation requires at that step (Flow.ReachesBefore.reaches). At each condition a formation requires at a step, the levels with and without a part agree, or the part reaches the formation before that step (Flow.Balances.agrees_or_reaches_before, agrees_or_reaches); whatever the part has not reached before a step is admitted alike with and without it there (Flow.Balances.admits_unreached_before, admits_unreached). An exchange after the dependence affects and reaches a formation without reaching it before any step, which is admitted alike with and without the part at every step (Late.affected_without_effect). What a part whose members lie within a region closed under affecting reaches lies within the region (Flow.reaches_within_closed); the reach closure and the system are such regions (Flow.reaches_withinReach, Flow.reaches_withinSystem), a part whose members lie beyond a system reaches nothing within it (Flow.unreached_within_system), and a formation's own part has its members within its reach closure and its system (Flow.own_within_reach, Flow.own_within_system); the clearer's part is its own and reaches the dweller (Clearing.clearer_own, Clearing.reaches_dweller). No Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 一般定理的前提只有平衡（Flow.Balances）；部分是判定的形成家族。
hypotheses.en: The general theorems assume only balance (Flow.Balances); a part is a decided family of formations.

hypotheses.zh: 有与无一个部分的比较用扣留水平（Flow.WithheldLevels）：扣留这一部分、其余交换不变时的水平，这是表示上的选择；两个流的比较另给第二个流。
hypotheses.en: Comparisons with and without a part use withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels): the levels with the part withheld and the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation; a comparison of two flows is given the second flow.

hypotheses.zh: 闭包、影响、共享与所及都是形成层面的：交换与依存各在某一步，不要求同一步，也不按时间先后；比较定理用按时间先后的 Flow.ReachesBefore。
hypotheses.en: Closures, influence, sharing and reach are at the level of formations: the exchange and the dependence each hold at some step, not necessarily the same one, in any temporal order; the comparison theorems use Flow.ReachesBefore, which is ordered in time.

hypotheses.zh: Clearing 与 Late 的结论：见证的流与网（Clearing.flow、Clearing.web、Clearing.sparedFlow、Clearing.sparedWeb、Late.flow、Late.web）。
hypotheses.en: For the Clearing and Late results: the witnesses' flows and webs (Clearing.flow, Clearing.web, Clearing.sparedFlow, Clearing.sparedWeb, Late.flow, Late.web).

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的长远目标：“I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”；Ren 要求“pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”。Ren 的层级：“i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：影响闭包读一个形成自身的反馈在效果经他者的支持与活动传递时所能计入的；所及闭包读 Ren 中间的“the system that one is in”（P40 把供给闭包读作所在系统，这一读法撤回）；系统（对共享条件的闭包）界定每个效果，却不读那一层级：一个共同条件就使它成为整体，系统划分形成，没有嵌套与中心；“situational awareness”读作中心知道其部分在反馈之外所到达的。名称（ClosedUnder、WithinClosure、AffectedBy、WithinInfluence、Affects、WithinReach、TakesPart、Shares、WithinSystem、Reaches、ReachesBefore、DiffersBefore、Trophic 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选；营养级联是生态学用语。
correspondence.en: Ren's long-term objectives: “I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”; Ren asked to “pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”. Ren's levels: “i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): the influence closure reads what a formation's own feedback can register once effects pass through the support and activity of others; the reach closure reads Ren's intermediate “the system that one is in” (P40 read the feeding closure as the system one is in; that reading is withdrawn); the system, the closure under sharing a condition, bounds every effect but does not read that level: one common condition makes it the whole, and systems partition the formations, with no nesting and no center; “situational awareness” reads as a center knowing what its part reaches beyond its feedback. The names (ClosedUnder, WithinClosure, AffectedBy, WithinInfluence, Affects, WithinReach, TakesPart, Shares, WithinSystem, Reaches, ReachesBefore, DiffersBefore, Trophic and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard; trophic cascade is the ecological term.

detail.zh: 复用扣留水平 Flow.WithheldLevels、Flow.Balances.withheld 与 Web.Admits；这里表明有与无部分的水平在哪里相同，以及部分在哪里被计入。
detail.en: Reuses withheld levels Flow.WithheldLevels, Flow.Balances.withheld and Web.Admits; here it is shown where the levels with and without a part agree and where the part registers.

output.zh: 扣留水平与扣留的算术恒等式。
output.en: Withheld levels and the arithmetic identity of withholding.

detail.zh: 复用影响闭包、所及闭包与系统；这里给出反馈计入什么、部分到达什么。
detail.en: Reuses the influence closure, the reach closure and the system; here what feedback registers and what a part reaches are given.

input.zh: 影响闭包之外不计入；部分只到达对影响封闭的区域之内。
input.en: Nothing registers beyond the influence closure; a part reaches only within a region closed under affecting.

output.zh: 清除者的部分；有它时栖居者从第 2 步起不被支持。
output.en: The clearer's part; with it the dweller is unsupported from step 2 on.

detail.zh: 在某步之前没有到达的同样被接纳，给出有与无部分的比较在所及之内决定。
detail.en: What is not reached before a step being admitted alike gives that the comparison with and without a part is decided within what it reaches.

detail.zh: 那里损失经供给者返回；这里反馈至多计入影响闭包，闭包之外的终结不被计入。
detail.en: There a loss returns through a feeder; here feedback registers at most the influence closure, and an ending beyond it does not register.

detail.zh: 以扣留水平的比较固定其余交换，影响闭包的动机来自经他者传递的影响：其余交换固定时，只有直接到达的部分被计入（Flow.Balances.admits_unreached），狼群经鹿对森林的作用在其中不出现（Trophic.mediated_unregistered，见 comparison-within-reach）；影响闭包是上界，不是所计入者的刻画。
detail.en: The comparison by withheld levels keeps the rest of the exchange fixed, while the influence closure is motivated by effects passing through others: with the rest fixed only the parts that reach a formation directly register (Flow.Balances.admits_unreached), and the wolves' effect on the forest through the deer does not appear (Trophic.mediated_unregistered; see comparison-within-reach); the influence closure is an upper bound, not a characterization of what registers.

limitations.zh: 形成知道其所及闭包、想要任何东西都不推出；部分是判定的形成家族，一个形成的某一动作要经第二个流比较（如 Clearing.unregistered）；回应的流在见证中是给出的；读法与名称是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: That a formation knows its reach closure or wants anything is not derived; a part is a decided family of formations, and one act of a formation is compared through a second flow (as in Clearing.unregistered); responding flows are supplied in the witnesses; the readings and names are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261011T011019.444120Z）：Becoming.Feedback 的 100 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 40 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 2115 项定理／3194 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261011T011213.027508Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 42 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §61；整合之前经第十六次独立审查（BECOMING-P42-P43-REVIEW.md），其处理见 §62.1；处理之后的文本尚未经独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261011T011019.444120Z): the 100 theorems of Becoming.Feedback all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 40 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 2115 theorems/3194 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261011T011213.027508Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 42 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §61 of the integration note; reviewed before integration by the sixteenth independent review (BECOMING-P42-P43-REVIEW.md), whose treatment is in §62.1; the text after that treatment is not yet independently reviewed.

next_delta.zh: 他者有回应时，由动力学给出回应的比较；中心怎样表示其所及；Ren 的判断：影响闭包是否读出形成自身的反馈。
next_delta.en: With others responding, a comparison whose responses the dynamics give; how a center represents what it reaches; Ren's judgment whether the influence closure reads a formation's own feedback.
